methodology: Labels are derived by running the deterministic rule filter over a hand-written ground-truth profile for each persona. The benchmark measures recovery of that conclusion from free text (extraction + retrieval). It does NOT validate that the corpus states Indian eligibility law correctly; that requires human verification against the live portal.
